name: Pious Ari
source:
Ariandra is a nun that's extremely dedicated to her god, Cira. However, her strict life changes one day as a mystery woman suddenly appears in her bedroom - and a new world is opened to her.

[From [url=https://noasfw.itch.io/pious-ari]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
阿里安德拉（Ariandra）是一位极其崇拜她的神西拉（Cira）的修女。然而，有一天，一位神秘女子突然出现在她的卧室，她严格的生活发生了变化，一个新的世界向她打开了。

[来自[url=https://noasfw.itch.io/pious-ari]Itch.io[/url]]
